description:
FILED s515c (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-11) from the Path-Tiny-0.150-0 board census (t/basic.t rows 113-118).

REPRODUCER (scratch/s515c/pr/glob2.pl):
    use File::Glob ();
    my $x = File::Glob::bsd_glob("{root}");
    my $y = File::Glob::bsd_glob("/etc/pass*");
    print "[$x] [$y]\n";          # perl: [root] [/etc/passwd-]   PCL: [1] [2]
perl's XS bsd_glob returns its LIST, so in scalar context the caller gets the LAST element; the shim (lib/File/Glob.pm, s514e #3160) ends `return _run(...)` and _run ends `return @r`, so scalar context gets the COUNT.

FIX (shim, one line): `my @r = _run(...); return wantarray ? @r : $r[-1];` (perl: an empty result is undef).  A lib/ change runs the full sweep.

REACH: Path-Tiny t/basic.t 113-118 (Test::More's `is` has a ($$;$) prototype, so its first argument is scalar context: the mock_bsd_glob rows and the four tilde-expansion rows Path::Tiny computes through bsd_glob in scalar context).

=== DONE (s515c) ===
Fixed in lib/File/Glob.pm (commit 2319080e): bsd_glob keeps its result list and returns `wantarray ? @r : $r[-1]` (perl XS: the last element; undef for none).  Guard: 3 perl-compared rows in Pl/t/file-glob-shim-01.t (bsd_glob scalar: one / many / none), inverse-verified FAILING on a 973bdb1d extraction.  Board: Path-Tiny basic.t 113-118 FIXED (the six rows left the blessed file by edit); companion op/glob.t 14/4 and lib/commonsense.t 0/0 identical on base and tree.
subject: File::Glob::bsd_glob (the s514e shim) answers the COUNT in scalar context; perl XS answers the LAST element -- `my $x = bsd_glob("{root}")` is 1, perl root (Path-Tiny basic.t 6 rows)
